articles.author: TateFletcher6754
articles.description:
Daily report email systems fail in a predictable place: the schedule is global, but the recipient's clock is not. For a US and EU audience, use one coarse cron in UTC and let application code decide which users are due on each run. That choice keeps daylight-saving changes and delivery guarantees in code you can test.
Short answer: run a UTC cron, select users whose local send window matches the current instant, and make the send operation idempotent. Treat the cron as a prompt to check work, not as a promise that every inbox is reached at an exact second.
The tempting design is one cron expression per user: 08:00 in New York, 08:00 in Berlin, and so on. It multiplies schedules, makes timezone rule changes harder to reason about, and still does not guarantee email arrival. A better design …
articles.title: Timezone-Safe Daily Report Email Delivery: UTC Cron Patterns for US and EU SaaS

articles.author: BlazePhoenix
articles.description:
Most DEX aggregators compute the route on a private server and hand you a transaction to sign. Between the quote and the execution the pool state can move, and the server's answer is something you have to take on trust.
BlazePhoenix is an on-chain DEX aggregator on Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum and Robinhood Chain that removes that step. The route is computed inside the transaction that executes it. There is no off-chain router to trust.
What the contract enforces
Minimum-out: the swap reverts unless you receive at least the minimum you signed.
Surplus to the user: any execution surplus goes to you, not to the router.
Verifiable quotes: the price comes from the Quoter contract, so anyone can reproduce it with a plain eth_call on their own RPC. Nothing is proxied through our servers.
Try it, no API key and no signup
SDK: npm i @blazephoenix/sdk

MCP server for AI agents: https://blazephoenix.xyz/mcp. The prepare_quote tool returns the exact eth_call to run on your node; decode_quote turns the result into the quote, a solvency check and verified calldata.
Raw eth_call against the Quoter on your own RPC.
Status: pre-launch. An independent external audit is scheduled before launch.
Links: https://blazephoenix.xyz · https://blazephoenix.xyz/llms.txt · whitepaper https://blazephoenix.xyz/docs/BlazePhoenix_Whitepaper.pdf (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23084091) · X @blazephoenyx · contact@blazephoenix.xyz
articles.title: The route is computed on-chain, inside the swap transaction: how BlazePhoenix quotes DEX trades

articles.description:
Every period tracker I tried wanted to predict my next cycle with "AI." Download a 200MB app, create an account, let the model learn my body. Meanwhile my actual question was simple: based on my last few cycles, roughly when should I expect the next one?
That is not a machine learning problem. It's a statistics problem.
Cycle prediction, at its core, is: take your last N cycle lengths, compute a central estimate, add a window. A mean or median over your recent history, maybe weighted toward recent cycles. That's it. You don't need a neural net to average five numbers.
The apps that market "AI-powered predictions" are mostly doing this same arithmetic, then wrapping it in language that sounds smart. The model isn't the point — the point is that you're creating an account and uploading your …
articles.title: Your period tracker doesn't need an ML model. It needs statistics.

articles.author: cognitalk
articles.description:
二次非剩余(QNR) vs 大数质因数分解：哪个更适合当前量子计算机演示


先给核心结论：
当前NISQ（有噪声中等规模量子）硬件，演示「二次非剩余相关问题」远比重大数质因数分解更现实；质因数分解是量子计算的明星算法（Shor算法），但它只在未来容错量子计算机上才有实用价值，现在只能做玩具级极小数字演示。
下面分模块拆解，先把两个问题和对应的量子算法讲清楚，再对比硬件门槛、演示难度、实验现状。
给定奇素数 $p$，整数 $a$，$\(\gcd((a,p))=1)$：
二次剩余QR：存在 $x$ 使得 $x^2 \equiv a \pmod p$
二次非剩余QNR：不存在任何整数x满足 $x^2 \equiv a \pmod p$



勒让德符号：
QNR问题典型任务：给定 $(a,p)$，判断 $a$ 是否模 $p$ 的二次非剩余。
BQP完全问题，也就是量子计算机可以高效求解，经典计算机很难在最坏情况下快速判定（概率多项式猜想）。
注意：QNR是判定问题（输出Yes/No），不是搜索问题。
给定合数 $(N=pq)$（$(p,q)$ 大素数），求 $(p,q)$。
周期查找问题：求函数 $f(x)=a^x \pmod N$ 的周期 $r$；若 $r$ 是偶数且 $a^{r/2}\not\equiv -1 \pmod N$，则 $\gcd(a^{r/2}\pm1,N)$ 就得到因子。
求证据的搜索问题。
判断二次非剩余，标准算法直接基于量子相位估计QPE，或者用更轻量的量子傅里叶变换QFT构造：
离散对数类的相位估计，但目标规模可以控制得很小。
✅ 特点：
输出只是1bit（是/否）；
可以选择很小的素数模数 $p$ 做演示，比如 $(p=7,11,13,17)$；
量子线路深度、比特数需求很低。
Shor = 量子周期查找（QPE+QFT）+ 经典后处理（gcd）。
…
articles.title: QNR(Quadratic Non-Residue) vs. Large Integer Factorization: A Comparison for NISQ Demonstrations | 二次非剩余(QNR) vs 大数质因数分解：哪个更适合当前量子计算机演示
